entities.name: Antausia
entities.description: Sparsely inhabited plane rich in rumored-to-be cognizant magic, seldom visited by planeswalkers.

entities.name: Valdusian Tomer
entities.description: Scholar who recorded Antausia's story and helped defeat Dinitra La Croix.

entities.name: Great Magus War
entities.description: War that raged nearly 600 years on Antausia.

entities.name: Selena Mistencharmer
entities.description: Owner of the Celestial Prism; with Slides Stardust killed Mandrake Nightshade.

entities.name: Slides Stardust
entities.description: Helped kill Mandrake Nightshade and curse the mountain.

entities.name: Dinitra La Croix
entities.description: Ruler of Beldingard for 80 years until defeated.

entities.name: Ignatius Firestorm
entities.description: Defeated Dinitra La Croix with Valdusian Tomer.

entities.name: Martuk
entities.description: Mage whose spirit permeates the Caverns of Martuk.

entities.name: Bosconius
entities.description: Largest city on Antausia, with a constant rainbow.

entities.name: Mandrake's Mountain
entities.description: Mountain cursed to imprison Mandrake's spirit.

entities.name: Beldingard
entities.description: Realm with pools of pure magical energy.

events.summary: Powerful wizards exploit Antausia's mana-rich land and the Great Magus War rages for nearly 600 years.
events.quote: For nearly 600 years, the Great Magus War raged on in the world.

events.summary: Selena Mistencharmer and Slides Stardust kill Mandrake Nightshade on the mountain's peak and later curse the mountain.
events.quote: Mandrake Nightshade , who was killed on its peak by Selena Mistencharmer and Slides Stardust

events.summary: Dinitra La Croix, ruler of Beldingard for 80 years, is defeated by Ignatius Firestorm and Valdusian Tomer.
events.quote: Ruled by Dinitra La Croix for 80 years before she was defeated by Ignatius Firestorm and Valdusian Tomer .
